subject: general
question: According to the United Nations which year is considered as the International Year of Indigenous Languages?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2019**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The United Nations declared **2019** as the International Year of Indigenous Languages.
 
• The aim was to raise awareness of the consequences of the endangerment of indigenous languages across the world.
 
• It sought to establish a link between language, development, peace, and reconciliation.
 
• Indigenous languages are essential to the identity of indigenous peoples, their cultural heritage, and the transfer of traditional knowledge.
 
• The year-long observance emphasized the need for preservation, revitalization, and promotion of indigenous languages.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• According to UNESCO, at least 40% of the 6,700 languages spoken around the world are in danger of disappearing.
 
• The loss of indigenous languages means the loss of valuable cultural heritage and traditional knowledge systems.
 
• Efforts to preserve and promote these languages involve documentation, community education programs, and policy support at national and international levels.
 
• The United Nations General Assembly adopted a resolution on 19 December 2016 to proclaim 2019 as the International Year of Indigenous Languages.
